visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit indoor restaurant where four individuals are seated around a circular table. Two cakes are on the table: a large dome-shaped pink cake decorated with small white pig figures and a smaller yellow dog-shaped cake featuring a single lit candle. (2) As the boy attempts to lean in and blow out the candle, the older woman playfully blocks his face with her hands, laughing joyfully. The young girl on the left claps enthusiastically while observing the interaction. The background features warm-toned walls and chairs with woven rattan backs. Yellow text overlays appear at the bottom while smaller parenthetical captions flicker above the characters. (3) The grandmother continues to playfully fend off the boy's repeated attempts to reach the candle, using both hands to gently push his head back or cover his mouth. The boy maintains a wide, excited grin, leaning forward with determination. The camera remains mostly static, capturing the high-energy physical interaction centered around the dog cake. (4) The camera shifts to a closer framing of the young boy's face. He stares intently at the candle off-screen, his expression shifting from a smile to a concentrated pucker as he prepares to blow. The older woman is visible in the background, watching him with an amused expression. A large bold text question occupies the center-left of the screen briefly.
